name: xiaoyaoyou-gpt
description: 逍遥游多人浏览器版迁移工程

scripts.check:fast: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run check:public-history && npm run catalog:verify && npm run content:verify && npm run oracle:golden-traces && npm run semantics:verify && npm run ux:verify && npm run probes:verify && npm run verification:verify && npm run architecture:verify && npm run room:contract && npm run setup:contract && npm run turn:contract && npm run reaction:contract && npm run damage:contract && npm run time:contract && npm run core-cards:contract && npm run action-tricks:contract && npm run defense-buffs:contract && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:full: npm run check:fast && npm run build && npm run test:replay && npm run test:bots && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run local:smoke -w @xiaoyaoyou/server
scripts.defense-buffs:verify: npm run defense-buffs:contract && npm run test:defense-buffs
scripts.action-tricks:verify: npm run action-tricks:contract && npm run test:action-tricks
scripts.core-cards:verify: npm run core-cards:contract && npm run test:core-cards
scripts.dev:local: npm run build && npm run local -w @xiaoyaoyou/server
scripts.damage:verify: npm run damage:contract && npm run test:damage
scripts.reaction:verify: npm run reaction:contract && npm run test:reaction
scripts.architecture:smoke: npm run build && npm run local:smoke -w @xiaoyaoyou/server
scripts.rooms:verify: npm run room:contract && npm run test:rooms
scripts.test:action-tricks: vitest run packages/engine/src/reaction.test.ts packages/engine/src/reaction.replay.test.ts && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/reaction-lifecycle.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:core-cards: vitest run packages/engine/src/reaction.test.ts packages/engine/src/reaction.replay.test.ts packages/engine/src/damage-dying.test.ts packages/engine/src/testing/damage-dying-engine.bot.test.ts && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/reaction-lifecycle.integration.test.ts tests/integration/damage-dying-lifecycle.integration.test.ts
scripts.setup:verify: npm run setup:contract && npm run test:setup
scripts.start:rooms: npm run build && npm run start:rooms -w @xiaoyaoyou/server
scripts.test:rooms: vitest run apps/server/src/room-store.test.ts && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/room-lifecycle.integration.test.ts
